_comment: Bootstrap configuration for a singleton AccountStateV1.
Replace verifier_code_hash with the data hash of the P-256 verifier you
actually deployed, and key_id with CKB_HASH(canonical P-256 public key).
aux is profile 0x01 || rp_id_hash[32] || origin_hash[32], where the hashes
are SHA-256 of the WebAuthn RP ID and origin respectively.
This file is an example and is not itself deployable.
